decisions.reason: The organic sliced platter has stayed on the website for two years without active promotion, which suggests it meets a modest aspiration level in a growing organic segment, so there is no shortfall strong enough to trigger problemistic search.

The premium sharing snack has been extended with a classic and a poultry variant, which signals that results meet or exceed aspirations and that the firm is investing further rather than searching for alternatives.
The organic boiled sausage was just launched with its own page and fits a staple category, so under uncertainty about early results the firm's slack lets it carry the product beyond its first year.
Launching the thin-sliced organic chicken breast in two flavours shows management commitment, and with results still uncertain after one year it is unlikely to be judged a clear shortfall yet.

The herb-coated organic salami is newly launched and complements the core salami range, so absent evidence of underperformance the firm will keep it while results accumulate, although the earlier exit of the organic poultry snack shows the firm does prune weak organic items.
